tx:
The potion can either be bought on the Grand Exchange or created with materials obtained in Herblore Habitat.
To make the Juju farming potions, the goal is to obtain grimy ugune and marble vines for the potion.
• If obtained all materials in Herblore Habitat, it requires 74 Hunter, 70 Farming, 64 Herblore, and either 59 Construction or 59,000 coins.
• Alternatively with 84 Hunter, 70 Farming, 64 Herblore, players can instead hunt igneous jadinkos on Anachronia, bypassing the lengthy setup detailed below.
Obtaining marble vine in Herblore Habitat
• Bring a hatchet, orange sapling, and around 11,000 coins to Herblore Habitat, plus 59,000 coins if you do not have 59 Construction. This can be assisted and the payment avoided.
• From Papa Mambo located in the northern section of the area, purchase a blue blossom seed, some ugune seed and 3-4 marasamaw plant traps.
• Plant the blue blossom seed in the vine flower patch located in the centre section of the area. This will cause common jadinkos to spawn in the northern area.
• Trap common jadinkos with the marasamaw plant traps until you have obtained lergberry seeds. As these drops are random you may have to trap quite a few of them, be prepared. Alternatively you can gain Favour points in the Jadinko Lair through cutting and burning jade vines or killing mutated jadinkos, and exchange them for seeds at the offering stone.
• Plant your Ugune seeds in the vine herb patch (a second herb patch is available to the east by crossing the large vine hanging over the water), plant the orange sapling in the tree patch, the lergberry seed in the bush patch, and construct a thermal vent in the construction spot. This will cause igneous jadinkos to spawn in the southern part of the activity area.…
